recommendations.reason: Five fragile bats currently occupy nearly the same individual width and height as the three Minion analogues. A smaller silhouette keeps the five-body swarm readable and distinguishes it from Beedrill.

The parallel increase makes the one-elixir Electric Spirit analogue 42x42 arena units, almost the same body as its evolved Electrode (44x44) and as a four-elixir electric mage. Thirty arena units preserve recognition without losing the small suicide-runner role.

The parallel increase gives Eevee and Umbreon the same maximum body height (42 units), while Umbreon acts as a 2100-HP front-line mini tank. A 48-unit body gives a modest tank silhouette, comparable to Arcanine and below heavy tanks.

Keep the parent correction. A trailing Object.assign in main would otherwise reduce the Princess analogue from 36 to 31.5 units in height. At 36 units it is readable beside the archers while staying fragile.
